statements.status_notes: CVE-2025-66506 is a memory-exhaustion bug in fulcio's server-side OIDC handler at pkg/identity/issuerpool.go (function extractIssuerURL), triggered by an attacker-supplied OIDC token on a fulcio CA endpoint. kyverno-reports-server does not import any sigstore/fulcio code directly (fulcio is an indirect dependency pulled via the opa/cosign chain) and does not run a fulcio CA, so the vulnerable HTTP handler is never invoked.
